name: auth-cookie-sign-in
notes: Captures the browser-cookie sign-in response. Cookie cryptographic material is intentionally excluded by the capture tool's safe-header allowlist; Rust tests pin Secure/HttpOnly/SameSite and cookie-only middleware behavior.

name: auth-cookie-sign-out-without-cookie
notes: Proves the route uses the browser cookie scheme and challenges a missing session with the frozen login Location.

name: auth-google-disabled
notes: Frozen default: Google authentication is disabled unless explicitly configured.

name: auth-cookie-google-disabled
notes: The browser-cookie Google exchange has the same fail-closed disabled default as the JWT exchange.

name: auth-password-reset-request-unknown
notes: Non-enumerating reset request for an unknown email returns the same public success envelope.

name: auth-password-reset-validate-invalid
notes: Invalid reset tokens fail closed without disclosing account state.

name: auth-password-reset-confirm-invalid
notes: Invalid reset confirmation is rejected; one-use success and atomic refresh revocation are pinned by PostgreSQL/Rust tests.
